task: Investigate /info API contract and documented redirects without changing release gates or defaults.
conclusion: The documented endpoint remains GET /info. No source evidence was found requiring a trailing slash or a different origin. Both local requests returned direct HTTP 200 without Location. The CI transport error remains undiagnosed by this local check; use its error.cause and manual redirect snapshot.

sources.finding: Network Info is GET https://arweave.net/info. No trailing slash is required by the documented endpoint.
GET with path segment info returns HTTP 200 and ar_info:get_info() JSON directly; this handler contains no redirect.
Official NGINX metadata example matches ^/(health|info|metrics|tx_anchor)$ and proxies it upstream without a slash redirect.
Prefix /info routes to trusted_arweave_nodes. auto_host_rewrite and internal_redirect_policy handle upstream redirects; no client /info-to-/info/ redirect is configured in this route.
Release 88 (16 November 2026) describes arweave.net as HyperBEAM and documents Accept: application/json behavior for transaction data. This is not evidence of changing the /info endpoint.

limits: Local requests use this environment and its network path, not the GitHub Actions runner.
Public documentation and source do not prove the deployment configuration of every regional CDN edge.
No turbo-gateway requests were made in this investigation.
No source files or default node settings were changed.
